qA8SfTTMPC7y19ac.name: Skills
qA8SfTTMPC7y19ac.description: Choose any two skills from the Technical skill group or Streetwise — the rigger’s bench of Engineering, Repair, Electronics, and street know-how. Skip your subclass skill (Drone Jockey: Electronics, Vehicle Rig-Pilot: Piloting, Facility Rigger: Security Systems); it’s granted separately. (Quick Build: Engineering, Repair.)

TNj4GEVXkuvyrgcj.name: Kit
TNj4GEVXkuvyrgcj.description: You can use and gain the benefits of a light Kit (no armor or light armor, and no heavy weapon), or the moderate Streetsweeper Kit. A Wrench carries their weight through the fleet, not the body. The three rigger Kits come first: Fabricator’s Bench, Rigger’s Harness, and Field Chassis. (Quick Build: your subclass’s starter Kit — Drone Jockey: Fabricator’s Bench, Vehicle Rig-Pilot: Rigger’s Harness, Facility Rigger: Field Chassis.)

m3P8Ey46dbyMQLiB.name: Wrench Subclass
m3P8Ey46dbyMQLiB.description:
Choose the role you grew into — all three are street-taught, with no corp academy: Drone Jockey (a swarm of small deployables), Vehicle Rig-Pilot (one big platform you Jump into), or Facility Rigger (a building turned into a weapon). Each grants a skill and its own ability ladder. (Quick Build: Drone Jockey.)

Your subclass determines your heroic abilities: you choose from its Base Tier at 1st level, its 7-cost band (or Focus Fire) at 3rd, its 9-cost band at 5th, and its 11-cost band at 8th.

XGfnVf3lAXfbL2CX.name: Signature Abilities
XGfnVf3lAXfbL2CX.description: You gain all four Wrench signature abilities: Deploy & Command, Rigged Fire, Field Repair, and Override Ping. None of them costs Uptime.
